meta.title: SerieN UI V2.1 — code/DOM binding map for Codex
meta.rule: Every new control carries data-ctrl="<CTRL id>". Wiring reuses existing engine functions; capability NEW-FUNCTION-NEEDS-CODE is UI-only unless stated.

controls.name: Login Google
controls.wiring: No logic change. Restyle only; keep ids, texts, status role.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged behaviour and copy; visual skin only (enamel plate, brass button). Gate keeps body.auth-locked and loads the simulator only when allowed.
controls.tests: access-gate.test.js; local auth fixture in all browser-*.py
controls.acceptance: All six auth states render; no simulator DOM visible while locked; no credential in UI package.
controls.decision: V1 reference has no auth gate (dossier §10.2).

controls.name: Logout ("Esci")
controls.wiring: Move the existing #signOut node into the Menu. Before calling the existing handler, open the guard listing RAM-only data (projects/draft/depot via trainManagement snapshot). Exit to title: button#exitTitle disabled, aria-disabled, reason text; no handler.
controls.designed_behaviour: Sign out stays operative. Before signing out a guard lists the RAM-only data (confirmed projects, unconfirmed draft, depot records) that a reload will lose. "Exit to title" is visible but disabled with reason until a real destination exists.
controls.acceptance: Sign out asks first when session data exists; Exit to title is disabled and says why.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-18 MODIFIED — Sign out real; Exit to title not operative.

controls.name: Graphics quality
controls.wiring: Segmented buttons call quality.setMode(mode) through the same applyQuality path (or keep a hidden #quality select as proxy and dispatch change). Auto label shows resolved profile.
controls.designed_behaviour: Four engine modes; Cinema maps to the engine profile "cinema".
controls.tests: quality.test.js; all browser tests that set #quality=low → migrate via tests/ui_selectors.py set_quality()
controls.acceptance: Four modes selectable; Cinema reaches the engine profile "cinema".
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-03 APPROVED — Cinema reinstated.

controls.name: Home (header)
controls.wiring: Same call nav.select("overview") + #cameraView sync. Remove header Home.
controls.designed_behaviour: Header "Home" is a camera action, not a main menu. Keep it as Recenter on #cam; Menu button is a separate new control.
controls.acceptance: Recenter returns to Overview preset exactly as header Home did.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-04 APPROVED — Home/Recenter is a camera action; Menu is a separate control.

controls.name: Track plan
controls.wiring: Keep the generated canonical SVG. Labels interactive ONLY if wired to requestToggle(id,"plan") with the same guard/messages as tiles; otherwise render labels read-only. Keep link to docs/consolidation/index.html.
controls.designed_behaviour: Opens #tpD. Labels may toggle switches ONLY through the protected requestToggle(id,"plan") dispatcher (same guard and messages as the panel); without a verified link they stay read-only.
controls.acceptance: Plan opens/closes; a label click on a protected switch shows the same blocked message as the tile.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-13 — labels only via the protected R1 dispatcher, otherwise read-only.

controls.name: Help
controls.wiring: Static content per design V2.1 help (keys: Space = stop selected, 1–4, Composer shortcuts; status & safety; route disclaimer; Z21 note; Kenney credit; TM).
controls.designed_behaviour: #hlD: keys aligned with the engine (Space = stop selected train, 1–4), status & safety (Running/Paused, Bell, Last operation), route-preview disclaimer, Z21 note, Train Management, Composer shortcuts.
controls.acceptance: Every topic of the old help is present in #hlD (checklist in FUNCTIONAL_COVERAGE).
controls.decision: Content loss risk if V1 #hlD replaces the old help verbatim.

controls.name: Route preview
controls.wiring: Same handler/timer; keep title "not movement authority"; aria-pressed from updateRouteHighlight().
controls.designed_behaviour: Same 15 s toggle; tooltip keeps the disclaimer; button shows remaining seconds ring.
controls.acceptance: 15 s timer and disclaimer preserved; second click hides.

controls.name: View preset
controls.wiring: Buttons call nav.select(preset); show "Free camera" when nav.preset==="manual" (read in tick like #cameraView today).
controls.designed_behaviour: Segments must be the engine presets: Overview, Station, Freight yard, Follow. "Free" appears as passive state label.
controls.acceptance: Four engine presets reachable; manual gesture shows Free camera.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-08 APPROVED — engine preset names; Free camera as manual state.

controls.name: Zoom in/out
controls.wiring: mountViewControls host = new container; keep its button wiring (ids may stay).
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Same step as today.

controls.name: Pan / Orbit drag mode
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Mode toggles and pressed state reflects engine.

controls.name: Home / Follow (toolbar)
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Follow tracks the selected train; manual gesture stops follow.

controls.name: Turnout tile
controls.code_anchor: app.js ui() builds #switchList from switchSpecs; requestToggle(controlId,"panel"); switchHUDState() sets disabled/title
controls.wiring: Render from switchSpecs (never hard-coded); Straight/Diverging segment reflects s.on; click → requestToggle(id,"panel"); blocked → disabled + visible reason from safetyByControl.message; counter on/total. Keep turnoutInteraction panel linkage (panel:$("switchList") → new container with [data-switch-hover] cells).
controls.designed_behaviour: Tiles generated from the engine registry (8 real IDs). Blocked tile shows lock + reason text (not only title). Only the engine state flips the segment.
controls.acceptance: 8 tiles with real IDs; blocked reason readable without hover; counter diverging/total.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-12 APPROVED — eight real switches from the registry.

controls.name: Daylight slider
controls.wiring: Keep id="day" and handler; V1 lighting tokens (--n/--k) driven by the same value; Day/Sunset/Night labels.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged range; UI lighting tokens --n/--k follow.
controls.acceptance: Thresholds 42/72 kept for engine glyph semantics.

controls.name: Rolling stock source
controls.new_dom: TM Catalog toolbar segmented + Menu segmented ([data-roll=native|kenney])
controls.wiring: Both proxy to the existing updateModels(): keep a hidden <select id="rollingModels"> as state holder or refactor updateModels(mode) without changing its validation/rollback. Show the engine message in Last operation and as TM alert.
controls.designed_behaviour: Not removed: relocated. Same validation and rollback message, shown as enamel alert in TM and in the ops log.
controls.tests: browser-consist.py, browser-phase-*.py, browser-train-deck.py, browser-train-management.py, browser-train-side.py, capture-train-sides.py
controls.acceptance: Switch available; blocked change shows the engine message and reverts the control.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-14 APPROVED — selector preserved (TM Catalog + Menu).

controls.name: Next mission
controls.wiring: Keep id and handler; always enabled; progress bar only if derived from statuses[mission].detail()/done().
controls.designed_behaviour: Always enabled, cycles the 4 missions as the engine does; completion tick shown.
controls.acceptance: Next mission enabled even when the mission is not complete.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-15 APPROVED.

controls.name: Train selection tabs
controls.wiring: Every engine train gets a card (0..4); selection via onSelect(id); keys 1–4. Retire tabs only when every train is reachable in the carousel.
controls.designed_behaviour: V1 shows every train as a card in a scrollable carousel, so no hidden train. Keep selection semantics.
controls.acceptance: Every engine train reachable in ≤1 click; 4 trains on 1024 width visible via carousel arrows.
controls.decision: V1 removes the tab bar; acceptable only because every train is a card (discoverability preserved).

controls.name: Train speed slider
controls.wiring: Throttle = train.speed via setTrainSpeed(); needle = |train.velocity| (actual, already in engine). No new physics.
controls.designed_behaviour: Slider = commanded; needle = actual velocity. Needs speedActual from engine (velocity exists).
controls.acceptance: Slider never shows actual; needle never shows commanded.

controls.name: Reverse
controls.wiring: Keep data-command values and handlers (onSelect + callback). aria-pressed from train.dir<0.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Pressed state mirrors dir<0.

controls.name: Stop (single)
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Stops only that train.

controls.name: Lights
controls.wiring: Same; aria-pressed from train.lights.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: Pressed state from engine.

controls.name: Uncouple tail
controls.wiring: Same; message → Last operation.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged; message routed to slip/log. TM never issues this command.
controls.acceptance: Engine message shown; detached wagon appears in TM On the Layout > Detached.

controls.name: Couple nearest
controls.wiring: Same; all four refusal messages → Last operation (amber).
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: All four engine messages surfaced.

controls.name: Add train
controls.wiring: Keep id/handler; disabled when trains.length>=4 (as today); title explains limit.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same command; disabled at the engine limit read from state (4) with the engine message "A session supports up to four trains."
controls.acceptance: 5th press impossible; blocked insertion message visible.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-01 APPROVED — max 4 from real state.

controls.name: STOP ALL
controls.wiring: Keep id/handler; NO latch, NO release state.
controls.designed_behaviour: Momentary: one press stops every train including hidden ones; no latch, no Release state, no locked throttles.
controls.acceptance: One press stops all trains; the button never turns into RELEASE.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-02 APPROVED — no latch.

controls.name: Pause / Resume
controls.wiring: Keep id/handler; label/aria from paused; annunciator Running/Paused lamp from paused.
controls.designed_behaviour: Unchanged; message "Simulation paused."/"Simulation resumed." appears in Last operation.
controls.acceptance: Label and annunciator follow engine.

controls.name: Reset
controls.wiring: UI-only change: the modal asks first, then calls the existing reset body (extract the confirm() call to the UI layer; railway logic unchanged). Modal text includes the STALE notice. No hold.
controls.designed_behaviour: Explicit confirmation (as engine window.confirm) styled as brass modal: states that locomotives, switches and missions return to start, detached wagons are removed, copied projects become STALE, projects and virtual depot records stay in the session. No 900 ms hold.
controls.acceptance: Reset only after confirming; STALE warning in the modal; projects/depot survive.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-05 MODIFIED — confirmation, no hold.

controls.name: Train Management launcher
controls.wiring: Move/restyle the existing launcher (keep id); extra entries call the same open function.
controls.designed_behaviour: Three entry points open the same dialog #tmD. Badge shows draft dot when a dirty draft exists.
controls.acceptance: TM reachable from header (≥1024), Menu (all), mobile nav (≤600).
controls.decision: V1 has no TM at all (C-06).

controls.name: Select composition (TM)
controls.wiring: Keep data-composition and aria-pressed.
controls.designed_behaviour: Selecting in TM selects on the desk too (engine behaviour). Card shows status Moving/Stopped/Paused.
controls.acceptance: Selection mirrored in dock.

controls.name: Focus in 3D
controls.code_anchor: train-management.js "◎ Focus in 3D" (discard guard → onFocus; close)
controls.wiring: Same logic; guard via styled modal (ADD-09).
controls.designed_behaviour: Same; dirty guard shown as styled modal.
controls.acceptance: Dirty draft guard fires before closing.

controls.name: Copy to project
controls.wiring: Keep attribute and call.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same; result opens composer with link status MATCHING.
controls.acceptance: Copied project shows MATCHING until something changes.

controls.name: New project
controls.wiring: Keep data-project-action values for ALL project actions.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Only one draft at a time.

controls.name: Project name
controls.wiring: Keep label/attribute; counter is presentation.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same + live counter.
controls.acceptance: 81st char impossible; empty name blocks Confirm with message.

controls.name: Add model
controls.wiring: Tray calls store.add(modelId) (same as select+Add). Keep an accessible path equivalent to "Catalog model" label or migrate tests.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same rules; disabled cards show why. Tray is a presentation of the same store.add().
controls.acceptance: Invalid role never addable; reason visible.

controls.name: Reorder trailer
controls.wiring: Same calls; keyboard only on the selected rail vehicle inside the composer. NO drag-and-drop (EXT-01 deferred).
controls.designed_behaviour: Buttons/keys are the contract. Drag-and-drop is EXT-01 (needs code, maps to repeated move()).
controls.acceptance: Loco never moves; keyboard Alt+←/→ works.

controls.name: Flip planned orientation
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Renamed to avoid confusion with train "Reverse".
controls.acceptance: Label never says "Reverse train".

controls.name: Remove vehicle
controls.wiring: Same; disabled for loco with trailers.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Loco remove disabled with reason while trailers exist.

controls.name: Confirm project
controls.wiring: Same; never "Save".
controls.designed_behaviour: Label says session; success toast "Project confirmed — kept until this page is closed".
controls.acceptance: Never labelled "Save"; no cloud wording.

controls.name: Cancel changes
controls.wiring: discard() keeps its rule; replace window.confirm with the modal (ADD-09). Tests: replace page.once("dialog") with modal clicks.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same rule, styled modal instead of window.confirm (NEEDS CODE for the modal only).
controls.acceptance: Dirty → modal; clean → immediate.

controls.name: Compare with real train (link)
controls.wiring: Picker passes the chosen real train to store.link() (ADD-10); default = selected train.
controls.designed_behaviour: Picker lists real trains; default = selected. Picking a non-selected train is a view-level change (store.link already accepts any train).
controls.acceptance: All five statuses rendered distinctly; STALE offers "Copy current train".

controls.name: Side view zoom/Fit
controls.wiring: Reuse createTrainSideView() geometry/assets; restyle only.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same limits.
controls.acceptance: Limits 100–600 %.

controls.name: Add virtual depot record
controls.wiring: Keep data-depot-action values for ALL depot actions.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Records numbered D001…; label VIRTUAL always visible.

controls.name: Reserve for project
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same; no-slot state explained with link to Projects.
controls.acceptance: Never reserves a draft slot.

controls.name: Release reservation
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Notice shown.

controls.name: Remove virtual record
controls.wiring: Same contract; confirmation is UI-only.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same; disabled reason visible.
controls.acceptance: Disabled while Reserved with reason.

controls.name: Physical transfer (Place / Withdraw)
controls.wiring: Render as non-interactive text; keep data-depot-action="enter|exit" on non-button elements only if tests need them.
controls.designed_behaviour: Rendered as engraved locked plate, not as buttons; reason text.
controls.acceptance: Nothing in the band looks clickable.

controls.name: Bell mute (guarded stop)
controls.wiring: Use guardedStops.bell (real controller) and bell.snapshot; both controls reflect the same state; independent from UI sound. Move/restyle the existing scene button; do not reimplement the bell (T-02).
controls.designed_behaviour: Exactly the engine bell: rings while R1 holds a train at a guarded stop and the simulation is not paused; mute state visible (aria-pressed, label, amber when muted). UI sound is a different control and does not mute the bell.
controls.acceptance: Two distinct controls; bell state visible on the layout view; hazard text remains visible when muted.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): R-01 — Bell restored, no longer REMOVE.

controls.name: Guarded-stop status text
controls.wiring: Same text from guardedStopView(); restyle only.
controls.designed_behaviour: Engine text "<train>: Approach blocked · braking|guarded stop · <risk> · <reason>" shown while the hazard exists. V1 invented alarm slip, Collision/Points/Buffer lamps and thresholds are not shown.
controls.acceptance: Only engine-sourced warnings appear; no lamp without real data.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-10 MODIFIED — keep real guarded stop, R1 warnings and safety blocks; no invented lamps.

controls.name: 3D turnout click / hover identify
controls.wiring: No change; overlays must not intercept pointer events except their own controls.
controls.designed_behaviour: Overlays must not swallow pointer events.
controls.acceptance: 3D tap works with V2 overlays present.

controls.name: 3D train click select
controls.wiring: No change.
controls.designed_behaviour: Selection syncs card/marker.
controls.acceptance: Card highlights after 3D tap.

controls.name: Keyboard Space
controls.wiring: Keep: Space stops the selected train only (compat id "stop" assigned by train-deck to the selected card). Keys 1–4 select (new, UI-only).
controls.designed_behaviour: Same as engine: Space stops only the selected train when focus is not on an input, select or button; STOP ALL stays a separate command.
controls.acceptance: Space never stops all trains.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-16 APPROVED.

controls.name: Escape closes modals
controls.code_anchor: app.js Escape hides .modal; TM dialog cancel → requestClose
controls.wiring: Esc closes the top dialog; TM keeps its guard.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Dirty draft never lost by Esc.

controls.name: Next Switch HUD minimize/expand
controls.code_anchor: src/next-switch-view.js mountNextSwitchHUD (diagram, distance, exit, warnings, minimize)
controls.wiring: Restyle next-switch-view.js output into the #nx plate. Keep its real topology diagram and states. NO switch action from the HUD (T-01). The reference diagram is only a graphic mock.
controls.designed_behaviour: Next switch name, distance, train, real connection diagram (predicted route red, other routes grey), expected exit and engine warnings; minimize/expand. No Straight/Diverging commands in the HUD.
controls.acceptance: HUD shows diagram, exit and warnings; it has no actuating control.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-09 MODIFIED / R-02 — read only, diagram retained.

controls.name: Console mini-map (focus)
controls.wiring: Map uses railwayMapPath()/locomotivePoint() (train-deck-state.js). Focus keeps nav.focus(). No KPI.
controls.designed_behaviour: Map marker selects; a "Focus" action stays on the card (camera).
controls.acceptance: Focus reachable from card or marker.
controls.decision: V1 removes per-card mini-map (MIG-20).

controls.name: Console select (name/image)
controls.wiring: onSelect(id).
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: Clicking name or image selects the train; card shows is-active; desk, map marker and TM selection agree.

controls.name: TM Close
controls.wiring: Same requestClose().
controls.designed_behaviour: Same guard; styled modal.
controls.acceptance: Focus returns to the launcher used.

controls.name: TM view tabs
controls.wiring: Keep data-view values.
controls.designed_behaviour: Tabs show counts and draft dot.
controls.acceptance: Arrow keys move between tabs.

controls.name: Open confirmed project
controls.wiring: V2.1: card shows confirmed read-only; Edit → open(). If tests expect immediate edit, migrate.
controls.designed_behaviour: Engine opens directly in edit; V2 shows confirmed (read-only) first, then Edit — matches the existing "Edit project" path.
controls.acceptance: Clicking a confirmed project shows it read-only; a dirty draft triggers the discard guard first; a clean draft is closed silently.

controls.name: Edit confirmed project
controls.wiring: Same.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same.
controls.acceptance: "Edit project" opens the confirmed project as a draft; Cancel returns to the unchanged confirmed version.

controls.name: Depot model select
controls.wiring: Same values.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same list.
controls.acceptance: All 14 catalog models selectable; the choice persists while the Depot view re-renders.

controls.name: Track plan XML link
controls.wiring: Keep.
controls.designed_behaviour: Keep (V1 omits).
controls.acceptance: Link present.
controls.decision: V1 #tpD omits the link.

controls.name: Modal backdrop click
controls.wiring: Same; TM = guarded close.
controls.acceptance: Backdrop click closes plan/help/menu; on Train Management it behaves like Close (dirty guard).

controls.name: Operations log
controls.new_dom: .vp .win #lastOperation (role=status) — keep id "log" on the text node
controls.wiring: Keep log() writing the full message; amber style when the message is a refusal/warning (pattern list in UI layer, no engine change). Toasts may add, never replace.
controls.designed_behaviour: Always shows the last complete operation message, including R1 refusals and warnings (amber). Transient slips/toasts may add to it, never replace it.
controls.acceptance: After any refusal (e.g. couple while moving) the full engine text stays visible until the next operation.
controls.decision: RESOLVED (Regia 2026-11-11): C-17 MODIFIED — persistent full R1 message.

controls.name: beforeunload guard
controls.wiring: Unchanged.
controls.acceptance: With a draft, confirmed projects or depot records, reload/close triggers the native prompt; with none it does not.

controls.name: Startup / load message
controls.wiring: Keep id and texts.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same copy on brass plate.
controls.acceptance: 3 states designed.
controls.decision: Not in V1.

controls.name: Detached rolling stock list
controls.wiring: Keep attribute.
controls.designed_behaviour: Same data.
controls.acceptance: Uncoupling on the desk adds a row "<name> · Track <edge> · <mm>" with Detached chip; coupling removes it; empty text when none.

controls.name: Catalog card
controls.wiring: Presentation over PROJECT_CATALOG; friendly names (ADD-13) from a label table; never change modelId.
controls.designed_behaviour: Filters/preview are presentation only (no counts of availability).
controls.acceptance: No stock quantity ever shown in catalog.
